luxembourg.metaTitle: Apartment blocks to receive major energy renovation grants
luxembourg.title: Apartment blocks to receive major energy renovation grants
luxembourg.metaDescription: A new national package will help residents modernise older buildings while keeping monthly costs under control.
luxembourg.excerpt: A new national package will help residents modernise older buildings while keeping monthly costs under control.
luxembourg.imageAlt: Apartment blocks to receive major energy renovation grants
keyTakeaways: Grants cover insulation and heating upgrades
Priority is given to buildings completed before 1990

content.text: The new programme combines several existing incentives into one application. Officials say the simpler process should help apartment associations make decisions faster and plan work across an entire building.
Support will vary by project size, energy savings and household income. Buildings with the greatest potential improvement will receive an additional planning allowance.
What changes for homeowners
How to apply
Applications will be submitted through a single digital portal. Owners can first request an energy assessment, then upload quotes and a timetable agreed by their building association.
A telephone service and in-person advice desks will be available for residents who need help preparing documents.
Why the policy matters now
Housing accounts for a significant share of local energy use. The package is designed to reduce emissions while protecting residents from sudden renovation costs.
Industry groups welcomed the longer funding horizon, saying it gives contractors more confidence to hire and train specialist teams.
